decisions.reason: A schlager compilation CD close to the core reissue offer costs little to keep listed in a warehouse-backed online catalog, and its value is still uncertain after one year, so the option is worth more than its carrying cost.

The illustrated release series is a multi-model line built on the label's strength in curated editions, its potential is not yet resolved, and keeping it costs little while the firm offers a narrow range of products, so the option is worth keeping open.
